races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: This looks a good opportunity for BIBURY STAR , who caught the eye finishing well on his recent debut at Wolverhampton. I Know You By Now should improve on his opening effort at Newmarket, while expensive yearling Vallejo shouldn't be totally discounted given he hails from a stable whose runners can improve markedly on their second starts. races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: IRIS OLIVIA holds the clear edge on form and is taken to make a winning start for Charlie Clover at the chief expense of Nottingham runner-up Crimson Blaze . races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict: Lots with chances but MR NUGGET signalled he is ready to strike again when a recent runner-up at Wolverhampton and can go one better off the same mark here. Cancan In The Rain wasn't seen to ideal effect when fifth at Kempton last time and could emerge as the main threat off an easing mark, although Celestias Comet and Fallacious Promise also need factoring into this very open handicap. MR NUGGET CANCAN IN THE RAIN (IRE) CELESTIAS COMET (IRE)

races.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict: TAN RAPIDO won at this course in July and has returned from a break with solid efforts at Wolverhampton, including when shaping better than the bare result latest. Hucklesbrook looks well handicapped now, while Kiniro returns to this C&D, where he's twice a winner, and is worth another chance after his stalls mishap last time. TAN RAPIDO HUCKLESBROOK KINIRO

races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: FUSEBOARD won back-to-back races in the summer, the second over C&D in August in what looks strong form, and can complete a hat-trick on return from a 93-day break. Thriving 5-timer seeker Macarone looks a big threat, while Yachtsman is one of many to have slipped to a workable mark. FUSEBOARD MACARONE YACHTSMAN

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict: THE ANTHONY GOVER won twice at Wolverhampton over 9.5f in September and has held form well since so he's bound to be bang there if coping with the drop back in trip and different track. races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict: BRAVE LEADER won with plenty in hand on stable debut last month and looks the type to prove prolific this winter, so he's taken to follow up. Off Spin has discovered the winning knack of late and is feared most if proving as effective on all-weather, while Tortured Soul warrants a second look with much more in his favour.
